instruction:
Ambient Occlusion Bake

`C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\scene.blend` contains mesh `Surface` and a 512x512 image datablock `AO_Bake` already prepared as the material's bake target.

Bake ambient occlusion into `AO_Bake`, pack the image into the blend, and save the scene as `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\answer.blend`.

Requirements: `AO_Bake` must remain a packed 512x512 image; the baked image must have mean gray in `[0.45, 0.90]`; the fraction of pixels below `0.3` must be in `[0.03, 0.35]`; and the image must not be flat, with gray-channel standard deviation at least `0.05`.
source: Zhukov, Iones, Kronin 1998 — "An Ambient Light Illumination Model", EGWR (obscurance \ AO bake)
